series.title: Hydrologic Technician
series.statusStatement: Active (EMST OPM series register, as of 2026-10-23).
series.qualificationStandardVersion: Technical & Medical Support Positions group std (education may substitute)
series.educationNote: from EMST's series record; not yet checked against the OPM qualification standard, so confirm with the HR office

generalCompetencies: not mapped in this release (X9 USA Hire and FWCI parts not built; WP-09 open item 6)

roles.functionStatement: Produce monitoring data that are fit for decisions by keeping instruments, samples and data streams under verified quality control.

bands.indicativeBand: GS-3 to GS-5 (entry); GS-6 to GS-7 (journey)

majorDuties.duty: Deploy, maintain and verify field sensor networks

tasks.statement: Install soil moisture, temperature and weather sensors at remote field sites, recording location, height, orientation and installation conditions.
Service deployed field sensors on schedule, cleaning, recalibrating or replacing components and recording each action in the service log
Run side-by-side checks between deployed sensors and a reference instrument or manual measurement, recording offsets for data correction
Troubleshoot sensor malfunctions in the field with side-by-side checks against a reference instrument, recording each fault and fix.
Re-site a field sensor when site evidence shows siting bias such as shading, sheltering, sediment burial or animal disturbance, recording the change
Decide from telemetry and field cues when a sensor site needs an unscheduled visit or manual sample, recording the trigger and the outcome

majorDuties.duty: Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field

tasks.statement: Conduct side-by-side checks between a deployed water-quality sonde and a calibrated field meter at each service visit, logging drift
Collect grab water samples at locations and depths that represent the condition of interest, recording flow and site conditions at collection
Measure temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, conductivity and turbidity in place with field meters calibrated before use and checked afterward

majorDuties.duty: Manage field sample custody and field quality control

tasks.statement: Complete chain-of-custody records for every sample from collection to laboratory receipt, recording each transfer, seal and temperature check
Collect field duplicates, splits and blanks at the frequency the sampling plan specifies, labelling them so the laboratory cannot identify them
Report field conditions that invalidate samples, such as broken seals, temperature excursions or holding-time breaches, before results are used

majorDuties.duty: Collect trace-level and genetic environmental samples without contamination

tasks.statement: Collect trace-metal, emerging-contaminant or genetic samples using clean-hands procedures and the contaminant-free materials the method specifies

majorDuties.duty: Engineer environmental sensor-network and streaming data pipelines

tasks.statement: Transfer data from field sensors into the programme's data system, checking completeness and timestamps against the deployment log.
Version raw, flagged and corrected sensor data separately so that any released value can be traced to its raw record.

majorDuties.duty: Assure the quality of environmental data from collection to release

tasks.statement: Apply range, consistency and completeness checks to incoming field or laboratory records, flagging failures for correction before entry.
Review automated flags on a sensor dataset against field and instrument records, accepting, correcting or rejecting each flag.
Audit automated flags and corrections on a sensor or batch dataset, measuring false-flag and missed-error rates on a reviewed sample.
Audit an environmental dataset on a set schedule, identifying errors and anomalies and recording each correction with its basis.

majorDuties.duty: Design and manage environmental databases

tasks.statement: Enter field and laboratory records into a monitoring database following the data-entry rules, correcting records the database checks reject.
Query a monitoring database to answer a programme request, checking the result against known totals before release.

majorDuties.duty: Ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field

tasks.statement: Record reference observations at pre-selected validation points with the reference protocol, without access to the product's predicted value

majorDuties.duty: Design and steward field reference data for Earth-observation and AI models

tasks.statement: Collect labelled field samples to the reference protocol, recording the metadata that models and validators need to reuse them

majorDuties.duty: Operate small boats and work safely on water in aquatic, coastal and marine field settings

tasks.statement: Operate a small motorboat for field work, completing pre-launch checks, a float plan and a passenger briefing before departure

majorDuties.duty: Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments

tasks.statement: Conduct a job hazard analysis at the actual work site before field activity begins, naming each hazard present and its control

majorDuties.duty: Work safely on hazardous, industrial and energized field sites

tasks.statement: Follow a site health and safety plan at a contaminated or industrial site, observing zone boundaries, air-monitoring action levels and decontamination steps

majorDuties.duty: Record provenance and AI involvement in work products

tasks.statement: Record the source, date, version, method and any AI tool used for a dataset or analysis, using the organization's provenance template.

majorDuties.duty: Record field observations with protocol fidelity and data integrity

tasks.statement: Check location accuracy, photo documentation and required fields for each record before leaving the site, correcting errors while conditions can still be observed

bands.pctTimeNotice: % time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.

knowledgeStatements: Stop-work authority lets any worker halt a task they judge unsafe; the task resumes only after the hazard is assessed and the plan revised, and the person who stopped it is not penalized.
A no-blame incident review separates system and condition causes from individual error and sanctions only reckless or wilful acts, so that people keep reporting near misses.
